settlement_source: Per market rules: video of the live broadcast/stream of the specified event; if Kalshi employees cannot reach consensus on video, internal and external official transcripts. Series lists ABC, Fox, MSNBC, WSJ, Semafor, The Information, CBS, WaPo, Axios, CNN, Reuters, NYT, AP, Politico.
settlement_variable: Whether JD Vance says a specified word/phrase (exact, plural or possessive; slash alternatives either count) during a specified event (rally, press conference), in an official capacity; one market per word per event
timezone: ET unless stated (Expiration time 10:00 AM ET)
tie_handling: n/a binary; any count thresholds are per-market (unknown)
rounding: n/a; $1 binary, tick $0.01. Word must be standalone: fused unhyphenated compounds don't count; hyphen/space compounds do; tense/derivational inflections don't count
trading_close_vs_settlement: Trading continues after the event; close_time up to 14 days after originally scheduled date (event 2026-10-30 -> close 2026-11-13; event 10-26 -> close 11-09). Expiration moves earlier once event occurs and consensus reached (Rule 7.2; can_close_early=1). Exchange may keep market open 24h after a live stream for an official recording.
early_close_or_void_clauses: Event cancelled: if an 'Event does not qualify/occur' strike exists it resolves Yes, others No; otherwise resolves to last fair price at Exchange's discretion
Event postponed: market stays open if rescheduled within 14 calendar days, announced by end of following day
Latest expiration = 14 days after originally scheduled event date
Video consensus by Kalshi employees; fallback transcripts
Market Outcome Review (Rule 7.1) at sole discretion
Presence alone / inaudible private conversations on camera don't count; official capacity only
title_vs_rules_divergences: Title 'originally scheduled for <date>': event may be rescheduled; original date governs the expiry window
Title implies any mention; rules require official capacity, exact word/plural/possessive, standalone unit, with live video taking priority over transcripts
Official transcripts may differ from live audio; used only if video consensus fails

public_feeds_for_settlement_variable.name: Live broadcast/stream of event (C-SPAN, whitehouse.gov, YouTube)

toxicity_flags: Outcome known to anyone watching once event ends, but market stays open until Kalshi consensus: stale-quote sniping window
Live-stream observers know result in real time while book lags
Cancellation without 'Event does not qualify' strike resolves at discretionary last fair price
~151 open markets per series, dispersed liquidity
notes: Many open markets are for events already past (closes 2026-11-09/11-13) and effectively determined; resting quotes on them are adverse-selection bait. Middle of MENTION.pdf (clarifications) was truncated in extraction; details beyond plurals/possessives unknown.
